summary: Feed c059_crc to SIEM is degraded due to physical layer errors on ingress: VF-1 port 1 received 1,740 CRC/alignment damaged frames (error rate 0.0218% > 0.001% threshold). No packet loss on path was detected.

findings.root_cause: Faulty cable, optic, or duplex mismatch on the link into VF-1 port 1 (input) causing CRC/alignment errors - 1,740 damaged frames received, error rate 0.000218 exceeds 1e-05 threshold by ~22x
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM receives corrupted/dropped frames; damaged frames are discarded before analysis, causing incomplete flow/log records and gaps in detection coverage even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional traffic

recommended_fix.why: Physical CRC/alignment errors must be fixed at Layer 1 before packet broker processing - inspect/replace cable/optic, verify duplex/speed negotiation, and check optic levels on VF-1 port 1 input
